fusions.name: Bounding Draw
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then a bite that deals 10 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Quick Nip
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Skip the Queue
fusions.desc: Leaps you 3 tiles forward and restores 12 health to you, then increases your health recovery by 50% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Springing Reserve
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
